meta.name: [name]
meta.description: Krea 2 character LoRA for the RTX 5090 (32 GB) desktop. SOURCE: community training reports gathered 2026-10-11, NOT measured on this fork and NOT reproduced on this trainer - treat every value as a starting point. Recipe: Krea 2 Raw with quantization OFF (transformer and text encoder bf16), LoRA rank 32 / alpha 32, adamw8bit at LR 1e-4 (community reports Automagic converged slower on Krea 2 - use krea2_automagic_char_lora if you want to test that), EMA on at decay 0.98, batch 1 x gradient accumulation 1, 1024 ONLY (the 512/768 buckets are dropped because community runs reported low resolution hurt likeness; multi-aspect buckets around 1024 are still on). STEPS (community table, ~30 images = the 1800 default): 20 images ~1500, 30 ~1800, 50 ~2500, 100 ~3500 - interpolate between rows (e.g. 40 images ~2150, 75 ~3000). The in-app Step Suggestion panel now uses this table (meta.step_table below) when this preset is loaded and the model type is still Krea 2: it interpolates between rows, uses 1500 below 20 images, extends the 50-100 slope above 100 (capped at 6000), and divides by effective batch. Other Krea 2 presets keep the per-arch advisor, which suggests less for small sets. CHECKPOINTS: saved every 250 steps and max_step_saves_to_keep 100 so nothing is pruned on any run up to 25000 steps - keep them all and pick the best by likeness vs generalization, not the last one. CAPTIONS: .txt captions on (caption dropout 0.05). Set your Trigger Word in the job form; the sample prompts use the [trigger] placeholder, which the trainer replaces with it (and strips if you leave it blank). Text embeddings are cached and the text encoder unloaded, which is mutually exclusive with train.diff_output_preservation. VRAM CAVEAT: the bf16 Krea 2 transformer alone is ~26 GB, so an unquantized 1024 run on a 32 GB card is TIGHT and UNVERIFIED here (no GPU run of this preset yet). low_vram loads on CPU first and the text encoder (~9 GB) is not resident during training because embeddings are cached. If it OOMs, turn on transformer quantization (qfloat8) or layer offloading before changing the recipe. Sample previews: every 250 steps at 1024x1024, 30 steps, guidance 4.
